mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it signals an impending economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls below 50 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5 percentage point rise over the past 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both decline month-over-month, it signals a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Concurrent MoM declines in HOUST and RSAFS, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in payroll employment (PAYEMS), defined as a decline of > 100,000 jobs in a single month, signals a sudden labor market shock that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS declines > 100k in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a year-over-year decline and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a recessionary environment that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 decline and rising UNRATE, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (INDPRO) is above 55 and rising, indicating strong and accelerating manufacturing activity, it signals a positive supply-side shock that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.
